title: Education, not personal investment advice
summary: The platform teaches financial concepts and supports educational simulations, but it does not decide what you should buy, sell, or hold.

items: Learning choices can adapt to your educational progress.
Simulations and examples must show their assumptions and limits.
The platform does not turn your learner profile into a recommendation to trade a security.

body.text: Do not treat lessons, model output, or simulated results as a promise of performance or a suitability decision.

applicability.label: Financial lessons, projects, simulations, and explanations
